title: Gap mutation paths (resolve/update) bypass worktree write-targeting; harness .claude/worktrees/* not a recognized worktree class
wanted_capability: Gap mutations issued from a worktree session should land the repo-owned .bbox/gaps file change in that worktree so the branch carries the resolution. Two coverage holes vs the existing worktree-write effort: (1) bbox_gap_resolve / bbox_gap_update have no project/write_dir resolution at all — GapResolveParams carries only {id, resolution, note, superseded_by}, the handler calls gaps.write().resolve(&p) directly, and the rewrite lands at the gap record's durable project field (registered base). Only the bbox_gap filing path calls resolve_gap_project() for a worktree write_dir. (2) The worktree recognition set (resolve_managed_fleet_worktree, src/projects.rs:406) requires a bro-fleet/* branch and a worktree outside the registered root; harness-managed worktrees (.claude/worktrees/* on worktree-* branches, inside the root) hit the registered-root-descendant early return and resolve to the base — so even filing from an EnterWorktree worktree writes the primary checkout. Observed 2026-06-11: bbox_gap_resolve(gap-859ce761) from a session cwd'd into .claude/worktrees/edge-projection-streaming mutated the primary checkout's .bbox/gaps/gap-859ce761.json (uncommitted exhaust in the shared multi-tenant tree); the worktree stayed clean and was later removed — had the write landed there without being committed, ExitWorktree(remove) would have destroyed it, so the fix likely wants commit-or-carry semantics, not just write redirection.
missing_primitive: resolve_gap_project()-style write-dir resolution on the resolve/update mutation handlers (keyed by session/ambient cwd, since the params carry no project), plus widening resolve_managed_fleet_worktree (or a sibling resolver) to recognize harness-managed linked worktrees inside the registered root
fallback_used: Left the mutated gap JSONs uncommitted in the primary checkout and flagged them to the operator for a chore(gaps) commit after the beta line reconciles
evidence: .bbox/gaps/gap-859ce761.json (resolution landed in primary while session was in worktree)
resolution_note: Fixed in 0848f9b (worktree-scope-cluster): (1) bbox_gap_resolve/bbox_gap_update gain a write-targeting project param running the filing path's resolve_gap_project; ambient table fills it from dispatch cwd. (2) In-tree linked worktrees (.claude/worktrees/*) are a recognized write class via structural .git-file detection (no branch-name gate); plain subdirs/nested checkouts fail closed. Operator-decided semantics: redirection-only, knowledge-lane style — no daemon auto-commit; the session commits the worktree file and the branch carries it; discarding the branch correctly discards its resolutions; base copy survives the purge (redirected_ids guard). Note: this resolution itself was issued against the pre-fix prod daemon, so its file write lands at base — committed there manually; behavior changes on next daemon deploy.
